phase_a_orientation.summary: UserSyncService.sync(userId) is annotated @Transactional and performs up to five attempts in one loop. Each attempt fetches the profile from RemoteUserClient.fetchProfile(userId), then immediately writes it via UserRepository.saveProfile(userId, profile), returning after the first successful fetch-and-save. Any Exception from either fetch or save is swallowed and retried; after five failures the method returns silently. The repository exposes only saveProfile, so the current workflow does not pre-read or compare an existing local profile before remote synchronization.
